cards.text: Friend, grab your apron, because this is page one of the whole Bible. It opens with God Himself: "In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth."
Right now the earth is formless and void, with darkness over the surface of the deep. Friend, I spent YEARS in the back of a junk drawer, and even I've never seen dark like THAT.

cards.question: The earth is still dark and empty, but someone is already hovering over the surface of the waters. Who is it?
Into all that darkness, God speaks for the very first time. What does He call into being?

cards.text: God said, "Let there be light," and there was light. He speaks, and it's there, just like that.

cards.question: Once there's light, God separates it from the darkness.

cards.text: God saw that the light was good, and then He gives the light a name: "day".

cards.question: God has named the light "day". What does He call the darkness?

cards.text: There was evening, and there was morning, and that's the first day. On day two, God says, "Let there be an expanse between the waters, to separate the waters from the waters."

cards.question: When God makes the expanse, He puts some of the waters beneath it and some of the waters above it.
God gives the expanse between the waters a name. He calls it ___.

cards.text: Evening, morning, and day two is done. On day three, God tells the waters under the sky to gather into one place.

cards.question: God tells the waters under the sky to gather into one place. Why?

answers.text: So the dry land may appear
So the rain can begin to fall
So the light can shine on them

cards.text: God calls the dry land "earth" and the gathered waters "seas", and He saw that it was good.

cards.question: On day three, God tells the seas to bring forth the plants.
God says the fruit trees will each bear fruit with ___ in it, according to its kind.

cards.text: The earth produces the plants and fruit trees just like God said, and God saw that it was good. Evening, morning, and that's day three.
Day four, friend. God says there should be lights in the expanse of the sky to tell the day and the night apart.

cards.question: God says the lights in the sky will tell day and night apart. What else will they do?

answers.text: Mark the seasons and days and years
Warn of the storms coming in
Guide the sailors across the sea

cards.text: God says these lights will shine upon the earth. Then He makes two great lights, a greater one and a lesser one.

cards.question: Of the two great lights God makes, the greater light is made to rule the ___.
On day four, God makes the two great lights and nothing else for the sky.

cards.text: And He made the stars as well. Berry, one of my cookie cutter kids, is shaped like a star, and he spent EVERY night at the kitchen window looking up and asking what was coming next.

cards.question: The lesser of the two great lights is made to rule the night.

cards.text: God sets these lights in the sky to shine upon the earth, and He saw that it was good. Evening, morning, and that's day four.

cards.question: Day five. God says the waters should teem with living creatures, and ___ should fly above the earth.

cards.text: So God created the great sea creatures and every winged bird, and God saw that it was good. Not small sea creatures, friend. Not medium. GREAT.

cards.question: God blesses the sea creatures and the birds. Then what does He tell them?

cards.text: Evening, morning, and that's day five, friend. But God isn't finished yet.

cards.question: On day six, God calls the next living creatures up out of the seas.

cards.text: God says the earth should bring forth livestock, land crawlers and beasts of the earth. He makes them all according to their kinds, and God saw that it was good.
Day six isn't over yet. Then God says, "Let Us make man in Our image, after Our likeness…" and He's not done talking.

cards.question: God says He will make man in His image. What does God say man will do with the fish, the birds and the livestock?

cards.text: "So God created man in His own image; in the image of God He created him; male and female He created them." Nothing else God has made so far is made in His image.

cards.question: God blesses the man and the woman and tells them to be fruitful, multiply and fill the ___.

cards.text: God also tells them to subdue the earth and rule over the fish, the birds and every creature that crawls. That's a BIG job for folks who just got here, friend, and on MY first day in the bakery I couldn't even find the oven mitts.

cards.question: Then God tells the people what He has given them for food. What is it?
God leaves the beasts and the birds to find food on their own.

cards.text: Every green plant goes to every creature with the breath of life in it, and it was so. Then God takes one more look, and this time He looks at ALL of it.

cards.question: God looks upon all that He has made and sees that it is very good.

cards.text: Evening, morning, and that's the sixth day. And the heavens and the earth were completed in all their vast array.

cards.question: By the seventh day, God has finished the work He had been doing. What does He do on that day?

answers.text: He rests from all His work
He starts a brand new world

cards.question: Then God blesses the seventh day and sets it apart as holy.

cards.text: God blessed that day because on it He rested from all the work of creation He had accomplished. Don't hang up your apron yet, friend, because this story has a whole lot more pages.
